dataset.collection_notes: Real historical email subject/body only; MeAJOR original benign0 rows only, all merged spam/phishing1 rows excluded. TREC05 supports development and TREC06 source-held-out validation; TREC07 is final. Existing Phase4/5 tests are observed development evidence. Source, era, anonymization and imperfect ham labels remain limitations. Final Pot apparent-phishing labels were content-reviewed before any prediction; small repeated-campaign subset is not expert consensus or verified malicious infrastructure. No synthetic primary data.
dataset.validation_scope: Historical source/era-held-out archive diagnostics; limited independent-curator manually reviewed final subset, not deployment probability calibration.
